trial_nr.Description: Trial index within the run (1-20). Each trial spans three rows sharing this number: 'stimulus 1', 'stimulus 2' and 'choice'.

onset.Description: Onset of the event, relative to the first (non-dummy) volume of the run.

trial_type.Description: Which of the three events of a trial this row describes.

Levels.stimulus 1: Onset of the first-presented payoff option (a cloud of dots).
Levels.stimulus 2: Onset of the second-presented payoff option.
Levels.choice: Onset of the participant's button press.

prob1.LongName: Win probability of the first-presented option
prob1.Description: Probability that the first-presented option pays out: 1.0 for the safe option, 0.55 for the risky option. Only filled on the stimulus rows. The repository's 'risky_first' variable is defined as prob1 == 0.55.

prob2.LongName: Win probability of the second-presented option
prob2.Description: Probability that the second-presented option pays out: 1.0 for the safe option, 0.55 for the risky option. Only filled on the stimulus rows.

n1.Description: Number of dots shown for the first-presented option, which is also the payoff in Swiss francs if that option is chosen and pays out. Only filled on the stimulus rows.

n2.Description: Number of dots shown for the second-presented option, which is also the payoff in Swiss francs if that option is chosen and pays out. Only filled on the stimulus rows.

choice.Description: Which option the participant chose. Only filled on the 'choice' row; an empty value there means no response was given within the response window.
